title: Millcreek 3D buildings from LiDAR outlines (2023 lidar), planning estimate
snippet: Unvalidated planning estimate: buildings outlined and modelled from the 2023 lidar alone (roofer LoD 2.2), with county footprints only where trees hide a roof. Heights and areas in metres and feet.
description:
OUTLINE_SOURCE says whether a building's outline comes from the LiDAR or, under trees, from the county footprint; COMPARE_CLASS and COUNTY_IDS say how the LiDAR outline compares with the county layer. Every metric field has a feet twin (_FT, _SQFT, _CUFT). LiDAR outlines follow the roof edge (eaves), a median 0.39 m outside the county wall lines. Heights NAVD88 (see the scene-layers README).

Unvalidated LiDAR planning estimate from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (flown October-November 2023); not surveyed or field-verified data.

Coordinates: NAD83(2011) taken to WGS84 / Web Mercator with WGS_1984_(ITRF08)_To_NAD_1983_2011, the same as every layer in this set. Elevations NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres.

Records: canopy-toolbox/reviews/2026-10-22 in buschbrian/agol-python-scripts (branch canopy/classification-refinement). See ../2026-10-26/lidar-footprints/README.md.
accessInformation: Millcreek GIS; lidar: 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 (USGS 3DEP).
